reason: float32 BLAS matrix dot product can assign ULP-different scores to identical vectors at different row positions, violating the declared identical-score stable-tie premise.
fix: One canonical float64 elementwise product and fixed axis reduction is used for normal-corpus search, inserted documents and feature pools. No tolerance or rounding relaxation.
timing_note: The failed comparison and correction occurred before classifier fitting or final test generation; no attack-success or answer output drove the change.
